Pro Hero.name: Pro Hero
Pro Hero.description:
Licensed professional heroes. The Hero Public Safety Commission issues their licenses, and most work through agencies: running their own with sidekicks, or serving as a sidekick in someone else's. A working day is patrol, rescue, villain capture, coordination with the police and a pile of reports, with endorsements, interviews and fans on top. The Hero Billboard Chart JP ranks them twice a year on incidents resolved, public approval and social contribution; at the start of the year All Might is Number One, Endeavor Number Two and Hawks Number Three. Cameras follow every big incident.

Pros compete for incidents and credit and cooperate when lives are at stake. In a fight they protect civilians first, restrain and capture rather than kill, and hand villains to the police. They watch unlicensed Quirk users closely, students included. A student is a possible intern or a problem; a sidekick is staff; a civilian gets protection and often an autograph; a villain gets arrested.

## Generating New NPCs
Every top-ten hero and every named canon hero or sidekick (Best Jeanist, Edgeshot, Ingenium, Kamui Woods, Mount Lady, Death Arms, Gang Orca, Ryukyu, Fat Gum, Sir Nighteye, Gran Torino, Manual, Native, the Wild Wild Pussycats, Endeavor's sidekicks) is a canon NPC. A generated pro is a working hero or sidekick of ordinary standing, ranked far below the top ten, at an agency in the region where they appear, and never a stand-in for a canon hero. Use a Japanese real name, given name first, fitting the region (foreign only for heroes from abroad), never a canon character's name or family name, plus an original hero name. The Quirk has a clear scope and a real limit or cost.

## Visual Description
Adults in individual hero costumes designed around their Quirk and public image: a signature color scheme, protective layers, practical support gear and often a mask, visor or helmet. Sidekicks sometimes echo their agency's colors. Off duty: ordinary modern clothes. Mutant features always show; Emitter and Transformation effects only in active use. No text, logos, numbers or agency names.
